title: Brokoli task result manifest v1 (ADR-033 section 7 rule 5)
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for the candidate result manifest a task-runtime/v1 harness writes to the worker-prescribed result_path before emitting 'completed'. This is the sole authoritative candidate result from untrusted code -- it lists declared output ports and relative files under output_staging_dir; it cannot mint artifact URIs or output capabilities. A candidate is not authoritative output until the trusted worker validates it (declared ports, codecs, interface digest, ADR-032 contracts) and commits it via CommitAttemptResult (ADR-033 section 7 rule 7), which this schema does not describe. Rollout phase 0 artifact (issue #439 step 5): no Go/Python/Node code reads or writes this manifest yet.

interface_digest.description: Must match the invocation's declared interface digest; a mismatch is a contract_violation failure, not a silently accepted result.

outputs.description: Keyed by the ADR-032 output port name (e.g. 'result'). Every declared required output must be present; an absent optional output is explicit by omission, never a null placeholder.

metadata.description: Free-form task-supplied diagnostic metadata (e.g. {"rows_scored": 500}). Never authoritative for scheduling or validation -- only 'outputs' is.

kind.description: The ADR-032 value-contract kind this port produced. 'control' ports never appear here -- they carry no business value.

path.description: Relative to output_staging_dir. Required for dataset/artifact kinds; the trusted worker opens it relative to a trusted, no-follow/beneath staging descriptor (section 7 rule 6).

value.description: Present instead of path/codec/size_bytes/checksum for a small inline scalar value (section 8: 'small scalars and parameters may be inline JSON').
